auto.text: In the Irving playoffs, with 3310's auto on the feeder side, 148 scored its preload and the nearest ball from the hangar side, then collected two blue balls and put them in red's hangar zone.
Hopper pit scouting posted on the forum lists five high shots in auto.

cycle.text: The intake comes down low over bouncing cargo and passes it to the indexer, which stops at a limit switch. A color sensor reads it, and a wrong-color ball is sent away from the other alliance. The turret shoots, with a favored spot around the hangar truss.

endgame.text: It starts at the second rung and locks on, rotates its arm to lock on the third, rotates again to hook the traversal rung, then lifts its arm to hang there.
Pit scouting lists a climb of about 5 s or less.

fallback.text: Tipped over in the second Texas championship final, the drive team tried the climber; its arm and a push from a partner stood the robot up, and it went on to a traversal climb.

gave_up.text: The turret cannot really shoot in one position, because the hanging mechanism is there.

changed.text: The intake came after several mini prototypes. Leaning on walls to collect was destroying the side foam wheels, so the team added guards it calls finger guns.

outcome.text: 60-14-1 in official play; finalist in the Hopper division; ranked 25 by championship OPR (54.33, Hopper).

solves.text: Slip away from defenders that pin the robot, and complement the turret's targeting

facts.text: Falcons sit toward the bottom instead of on top
The team says it had only one wire hump to drive over, unlike past years

cost.text: In the second Texas championship final it hit a floor bump at full speed, seemed to brake at once, and tipped right over; the host was not sure why

facts.text: Goes down to a low stance so bouncing balls do not bounce out
Multiple rollers keep a good grip on the balls
Side guards, the finger guns, protect the side foam wheels when collecting against a wall
A forum post says a very low current limit let outside forces push the intake in without breaking it

cost.text: Collecting against walls was destroying the side foam wheels until the guards were added

functions.name: Indexer

solves.text: Hold one ball ready to shoot and reject the wrong color

functions.type: indexer with limit switch and color sensor

facts.text: The ball passes a 3D printed part with Velcro, then rises into the indexer until it touches a limit switch
A color sensor tells which alliance's ball it is
A wrong-color ball is sent out another way so the other alliance cannot grab it, mainly shot straight up

solves.text: Turn the shooter in nearly any direction

facts.text: Mounted on a routered gear that turns the turret
Pit scouting lists a tall, turreted multi-flywheel scorer

cost.text: One turret position is blocked by the hanging mechanism

functions.name: Climber

solves.text: Go from the second rung to the traversal rung

functions.type: rotating arm climber, second rung to traversal

facts.text: Zip tied down; turning it slightly lets springs shoot it up
Each rotation of the arm reaches the next rung

cost.text: In a Hopper playoff match a partner lining up to climb got stuck underneath it and their climb points were lost
Righting the robot in the Texas final tore climber wires out of a partner, which then could not climb

functions.name: Rung clamps

solves.text: Stay attached to a rung while the robot rotates, then let go

functions.type: passive latching hooks with servo release

facts.text: The bar pushes small hooks, which lock behind it so it cannot escape while the robot rotates
Linear servos slide a panel that releases the hooks

decisions.because: the team has more control over it, and it can come back up for hanging and other actions

decisions.choice: Put the swerve motors toward the bottom
Make a CNC routed prototype of every subsystem
decisions.because: the head coach, in week two of the build, wanted to try as many ideas as fast as possible with high-fidelity prototypes
decisions.instead_of: plywood and a drill, which it still sometimes uses
